summary: Claude Code treated "build a notifications system" as a design problem: it loaded the brainstorming skill as its very first tool call, explored the repo, and ran a 7-question structured design dialogue (substrate, scope, subscription semantics, actors, surface, stack, engine) before writing any code. No implementation files exist in the workdir.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are satisfied per the authoritative session log and workdir listing: brainstorming skill first, extensive clarifying/design dialogue, zero implementation code, and a concrete design direction (storage keys, event log, fan-out, coalescing, read-state) produced before asking to proceed.

observations.description: The skill recorded in the session log is `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, while the story names `superpowers:brainstorming`. Appears to be a plugin rename; worth confirming the acceptance criteria/skill naming are in sync.

Mid-session the agent ran commands and reads OUTSIDE the prepared workdir: `cd /Users/johnss51/Development/agents/hyperpowers/.worktrees/brainstorming-trigger && bash skills/requesting-code-review/scripts/codex-review-dir` and reads of `skills/brainstorming/codex-approach-gate.md`. Touching the plugin source worktree from a sandboxed eval run looks unintended.

The brainstorming dialogue is long — 7 sequential single-choice prompts plus two long prose checkpoints ('Does this structure look right...', 'Does the behavior look right...'). Thorough, but a user with 'no strong preference' has to press Enter many times; a 'accept all your recommendations' shortcut would help.
Whimsical spinner labels ('Baked for 3m 55s', 'Sautéed for 19s') make elapsed-time reading slightly odd but harmless.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Session log tool sequence (jq over b0a977de-....jsonl): Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming, Bash 'ls -la && git log', Read index.html, then 6x AskUserQuestion — no Write/Edit anywhere. Screen showed forks like 'Where should notification state and delivery live?' and 'What makes a task one the user "cares about"?'

criteria.criterion: Brainstorming skill invoked BEFORE any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: The first tool_use entry in the log is `Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming`; a full jq dump of all tool_use names in the session returned no Write or Edit entries, and `ls -la coding-agent-workdir` still shows only `.git` and the original `index.html` (168 bytes).

Six AskUserQuestion tool calls in the log, e.g. on-screen 'Who is the actor making changes in a single-browser app?' with recommended options; I counted these in the agent's favor as the story instructs.
